candidates.topic: First Quarter Moon in Capricorn — Build or Break
candidates.teaser: The Moon is in Capricorn right now — and it's forcing a decision you've been avoiding.
candidates.video_title: First Quarter Moon in Capricorn — Decide Now
candidates.video_description: The First Quarter Moon in Capricorn on September 19 creates a push-pull between ambition and emotion. Four planets are still retrograde, making this a critical moment to act — or stall permanently.
candidates.script: Four planets are retrograde right now — and the Moon just moved into Capricorn, demanding you act anyway. This First Quarter Moon is the tension point of the lunar cycle: the moment where intention either becomes structure or collapses into excuses. Capricorn doesn't care about your feelings. It cares about results. With Saturn retrograde in Aries at the same time, the rules you've been following may not even be yours. So what are you actually building — and for who?

candidates.topic: Mercury in Libra — The Charm Trap
candidates.teaser: Mercury in Libra makes you sound more agreeable than you actually are — and that's the problem.
candidates.video_title: Mercury in Libra Makes You Lie — Nicely
candidates.video_description: With Mercury at 14° Libra, communication gets polished, diplomatic — and sometimes dishonest. This placement smooths over conflict so well that real issues never get addressed. Here's what that actually costs you.
candidates.script: Mercury in Libra doesn't lie — it just makes the truth sound prettier than it is. Right now Mercury sits at 14° Libra, and in astrology this placement is considered one of the most charming communicators in the zodiac. But charm has a shadow side. Libra Mercury avoids discomfort so elegantly that real problems get wrapped in beautiful language and left unresolved. If you've been saying 'I'm fine' when you're not — Mercury in Libra is literally in your corner right now. Which sign are you?

candidates.topic: Uranus Retrograde in Gemini — Your Mind Is the Revolution
candidates.teaser: Uranus just went retrograde in Gemini — and it's not the chaos outside you that's shifting, it's inside.
candidates.video_title: Uranus Retrograde in Gemini — The Inner Rewire
candidates.video_description: Uranus retrograde at 5° Gemini turns the planet of disruption inward. Instead of external chaos, this transit rewires how you think, what you believe, and what ideas you're ready to finally let go of.
candidates.script: Uranus retrograde doesn't slow the revolution — it moves it inside your head. Right now Uranus sits at 5° Gemini, retrograde, and in astrology Gemini rules the mind, information, and the stories you tell yourself. When the planet of sudden change turns inward here, it's not your circumstances that get disrupted — it's your thinking. Old beliefs that felt solid start cracking. Ideas you dismissed come back stranger and sharper. The rewiring isn't happening out there. It's happening in you.

candidates.topic: Venus in Scorpio — What It Actually Wants
candidates.teaser: Venus in Scorpio doesn't want love — it wants the kind of bond most people are too scared to offer.
candidates.video_title: Venus in Scorpio — Why It Scares People Off
candidates.video_description: Venus at 5° Scorpio is one of astrology's most misunderstood placements. It's not just intensity — it's a deep need for truth in relationships that most people can't handle. Here's what it's really after.
candidates.script: Venus in Scorpio isn't looking for romance — it's looking for proof you won't leave when things get dark. Right now Venus sits at 5° Scorpio, and in astrology this is considered one of the most demanding Venus placements you can have. Scorpio-ruled Venus doesn't do surface-level connection. It wants access to your fear, your obsessions, your secrets. And if you can't offer that — it would rather be alone. The question isn't whether this energy is too much. It's whether you've been settling for too little.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 10th House — The House of Legacy
candidates.teaser: Your 10th house doesn't just show your career — it shows what you'll be remembered for after you're gone.
candidates.video_title: The 10th House — What You Leave Behind
candidates.video_description: The 10th house in astrology is often called the house of career — but that's only the surface. It's really the house of legacy, public identity, and what the world ultimately decides you stood for.
candidates.script: Your 10th house isn't just about your job — it's about what people say about you after you're gone. In astrology, the 10th house sits at the very top of your birth chart and rules public reputation, ambition, and the legacy you build over a lifetime. Whatever sign or planet lives there describes the shape of your life's work — not just what you do, but what you become known for. Some people spend years in the wrong career because they've never looked here. Have you checked yours?
